title: Registered Q3 fifth-energy moment to harmonic top-tail bridge
question: Does the registered Q3 onsite fifth-energy/history moment supply the weighted top-tail condition required by the harmonic truncated CCR, and what exact input is still missing?
method: Use P_top^(n)<=N^5/(n-1)^5 for the harmonic number N on the local oscillator basis, with n>=2.
Apply the scalar Markov estimate to obtain n^2 omega(P_top^(n))<=C n^2/(n-1)^5 and the limit zero.
Compare the required N^5 moment with the R-167 v2.2 definitions m5=sup phi(k_h^5), K_e^5 history transport, d5 and the declared Shubin graph statement.
Separate the missing reverse N-versus-k_h form inequality from the separate compatibility of harmonic compressions with the exact k_h/Ritz cutoff, then compile the scalar bridge in pinned Lean R279.
finding: R279 compiles without errors and proves the exact scalar implication: a uniform fifth moment for the harmonic number gives the n^2 top-projector tail required by EXP-001094 and hence the R278 CCR interface. R-167 v2.2 supplies a fixed-beta finite-periodic compact-source fifth moment for the shifted onsite energy and transports K_e^5 through its registered histories, but its issued fields do not name the reverse form domination N^5<=C_N(1+k_h^5) or the harmonic-compression-to-exact-k_h compatibility needed to instantiate R279. The existing M20 corridor is a coordinate bond moment and is not an individual number-tail estimate.
decision_reason: This closes a precise scalar/QFT-facing interface and identifies the first operator-domain/cutoff mismatch without promoting a conditional energy estimate to an actual Q3 harmonic top-tail theorem.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing bridge only. No Q3 Gibbs/history weighted top-tail uniformity, unbounded common-core transfer, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
next_action: Prove the reverse onsite form inequality and harmonic-number compression compatibility uniformly on the declared source set, or record an exact counterexample/obstruction before any direct D/delta-D or common-alpha promotion.

qft_interface.closed: A uniform harmonic-number fifth moment is sufficient for the weighted top-tail condition and truncated-CCR defect transfer.
qft_interface.open: The actual Q3 energy-to-number estimate, harmonic cutoff compatibility, source/volume/orientation/history uniformity, direct dynamics limit, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

adversarial_review.check: The top level is n-1, so the denominator is (n-1)^5 and the limit uses n^2/(n-1)^5; no n versus n-1 factor is hidden.
R279 assumes a fifth moment of harmonic N; the R-167 k_h moment is not silently renamed N^5.
The required N^5<=C_N(1+k_h^5) relation is explicitly a form-domain input; scalar order of noncommuting p and q is not used as a proof.
Harmonic matrix compression and parity-preserving k_h spectral/Ritz restriction are kept as separate cutoffs; convergence between them is not assumed.
The M20 bound is recognized as an edge coordinate moment and is not used to control individual momentum-sensitive top projectors.
No finite-regulator bridge is promoted to common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, a mass gap, continuum, Sector A or Pre-A.
